decisions.title: Short navigation probe after click instead of 8s waitForNavigation
decisions.rationale: Same-page clicks were blocking ~8s per agent step because waitForNavigation always timed out. Now probe 400ms (1000ms for Enter); full domcontentloaded settle only when URL/navigation actually changes.
decisions.rejected: Keep 8s waitForNavigation on every click - simple but adds ~8s latency per same-page interaction; rejected for agent loops.

decisions.title: Record/Replay as a mode toggle on the existing Record node (not a new node type)
decisions.rationale: Reuse captured RecordedStep[] in place. mode?: 'record'|'replay' (optional, defaults 'record') keeps old boards valid. Replay compiles steps via shared pure compileRecordedSteps() into goto/click/fill/scroll FlowSteps with settle waits; record mode keeps the browser open for capture as before. Editing happens inline in the node so users can change e.g. input 100 -> 10.
decisions.rejected: Separate 'Replay' node type - duplicates RecordedStep wiring, profile resolution, serialization, and forces copying steps between two nodes; rejected for redundancy and worse UX.
